application_review: PROGRESS. Previous round rechecked and all retained proof hashes preserved.

The weighted sampling result retains the supplied actual nonnegative normalized cell probabilities. It selects one sample tuple for the aggregate error, rather than separately changing the law in each cell.
Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz is proved from the existing weighted square inequality and root Haar Cauchy-Schwarz, with all coefficients retained.
The dual approximation is an empirical mean of actual nonroot cube products. Its unit bound follows from the unit bounds of those products and m>0.
The existential sample tuple precedes universal quantification over bounded tests. Thus all such tests share the same approximation and squared correlation error bound 1/m.
Four new theorems are individually audited. Neither a high-order concatenation assertion nor a substitute probability system is introduced; the principal Bessel and inverse gaps remain.
